description: Hand-wired 3-layer circuit: prev-token heads build char 4-grams, match head (with '|' sink) flags s2 4-grams present in s1, averaging head gives overlap fraction; output 1 if > 0.35.
Same circuit, but averaging head only counts s2 4-grams made of 4 letters (content-word substrings, no spaces); output 1 if fraction found in s1 > 0.30.
Calibration baseline: same overlap circuit with THETA=-1, so the readout always emits '1' (MRPC majority class).
